summary: Writes TOP image data to a named shared-memory block for another TouchDesigner process or third-party application to read.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Cook the input and write to shared memory while enabled.

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Shared memory block name to write.

key_params.name: local
key_params.note: Use a unique local shared memory segment.

key_params.name: global
key_params.note: Use the combined global shared memory segment.

key_params.name: downloadtype
key_params.note: Immediate slow transfer or next-frame fast transfer.

common_gotchas: Receiver name, memory type, resolution, and pixel format must be coordinated.
Use Local for applications other than TouchDesigner.
Only one Out process can safely own a Global shared-memory stream on a machine.
Next-frame download is faster but adds one-frame latency.
key_concepts: Shared Mem Out cooks its input and writes image data to a named shared-memory block while active.
Local and Global memory types determine whether the block is unique or part of the combined TouchDesigner shared segment.
Download Type trades immediate transfer latency against faster next-frame behavior.
Receivers must use the same name, memory type, and compatible image layout.
